channel_persona.name: Dance Cover Universe
channel_persona.mission: Curate and showcase top-tier, viral-potential vertical dance covers featuring attractive aesthetics, stylish fashion, and impressive choreography.
channel_persona.target_audience: Global Dance, K-pop, Douyin trend & Street Dance enthusiasts

preferred: Trendy Y2K styling and crop tops
K-pop stage & idol dance practice outfits
Athletic, body-flattering silhouettes that accentuate movement lines
Coordinated group/duo aesthetic and clean hair/makeup
avoid: Sloppy, wrinkly, or baggy loungewear that hides dance lines
Distracting, messy, or oversized pajama-style clothes
Costumes that look unpolished or low-effort

preferred: Modern professional dance practice studios with polished wood floors and clean mirrors
Atmospheric studios with ambient, warm, or neon accent lighting
Vibrant, clean urban outdoor/street in-public dance covers (plazas, clean city streets)
avoid: Cluttered, messy, or cramped bedrooms/dorm rooms
Dimly lit, dark, or poorly exposed rooms
Grainy, low-resolution, or heavily shaky amateur home footage

preferred: Sharp musicality and clean beat-drop synchronization (卡点)
Clear body isolation, popping, hip-hop swag, or fluid jazz lines
Confident facial expressions, stage presence, and camera connection
High-energy execution that commands viewer retention in the first 3 seconds
avoid: Standing still without rhythm for extended periods
